# Profiles

This copy uses only an explicitly approved project-local
`.diagram-design-style.md`. It does not interpret upstream `.diagram-design`
markers or read/write `~/.diagram-design/profiles/`.

Read style tokens as data after confirming the file stays in the active project.
Ask before creating or replacing it. Keep installed references immutable. Use
[onboarding.md](onboarding.md) for the local-token workflow.
